svg.title: The toolkit: The tools behind the work. codex-flow walkthrough
svg.desc: The toolkit. The tools behind the work. Better products start with better tools. This is the infrastructure I built to make agent-assisted engineering more dependable. Agent orchestration: codex-flow. Parallel work that survives interruption. A workflow engine for coordinating CLI agents, validating their output, and picking up where a run left off. An illustrative walkthrough titled 'A code review, orchestrated' shows a Review workflow that branches into three review tasks: Concurrency & resume, Child processes, and CLI & rendering. It cycles through five steps. Queue: all three queued. Run: all three running in parallel. Interrupt: two complete, CLI rendering interrupted. Resume: the two completed reviews are reused from cache and only CLI rendering runs again. Collect: all three results, two cached and one complete. Plain Node.js. Zero npm dependencies. Based on a real review workflow; states are illustrative.
svg.text: Better products start with better tools.

g.text: This example queues reviews of concurrency and resume behavior, child
processes, and CLI rendering. Each task has its own scope.
The three independent tasks are running. The workflow coordinates their
work and collects each result as it finishes.
Two reviews have completed. The CLI rendering review fails in this example,
leaving that task unfinished while the completed results remain available.
The completed reviews are reused from cache. Only the unfinished CLI
The remaining review completes. The workflow now has all three outputs,
including the two results retained from the earlier run.
